summary.text: Noah Robinson is a Republican member of the Oregon State Senate for District 2, which his legislative page associates with Cave Junction.
His biography says he holds a PhD in chemistry from Caltech and is the son of the previous District 2 senator, Art Robinson.

paragraphs.text: Robinson was raised in Cave Junction and homeschooled with his siblings, according to his biography.
He graduated in two years with a bachelor's degree in chemistry from Southern Oregon University after entering the program as a junior.

After earning his PhD in chemistry from Caltech, he worked with Nobel laureate Bruce Merrifield at Rockefeller University and with his father at the Oregon Institute of Science and Medicine on research into peptide deamidation.
